$comment: Part VI — Concluding statements / signature (EA I73 'info-signature'). Hand-authored (administrative INFORMATION block, not a criterion). Response-only: it lives under cac:Signature of the QualificationApplicationResponse. CAVEAT: no Schematron rule and no instance in ESPD-Response-BASE.xml constrain or exemplify this block; the shape is derived from the EA I73 model (SIGNATURE 0..1 -> SignatoryParty 0..1 -> PhysicalLocation 0..1, whose only leaf is cbc:Name) and UBL 2.4 SignatureType. The whole block, and every field in it, is OPTIONAL. REVIEW against a real signed instance when one is available (same situation Part I §A / Part II §B were in before samples existed).
title: ESPD Part VI — Signature

signatory.description: The signatory of the ESPD response. Maps to cac:Signature/cac:SignatoryParty (EA I73 SIG1/SP1, both 0..1). The EA model exposes exactly one leaf under it: the signatory party's physical-location name. Modelled as a single optional field; the signatory object itself is optional (an unsigned response is structurally valid).

physicalLocationName.description: Name of the physical location of the signatory party (e.g. the place of signing). Maps to cac:SignatoryParty/cac:PhysicalLocation/cbc:Name (EA I73 SIG1/SP1/PL1).
